title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — provider-neutral EDO contract
purpose: Continue the owner-authorized programme with the offline-buildable provider-neutral EDO contract from sections 25-26: exact route vocabulary, exact adapter surface, exact provider-neutral states, fail-closed UNKNOWN/reconciliation semantics, one-organization binding rules for Diadoc/Saby and the rule that an existing 1C-EDO route is not silently duplicated by a second automatic channel.
boundaries: No live Diadoc, Saby or 1C-EDO API call and no vendor credential.
No customer password field or password-based provider authorization is introduced.
No second automatic EDO channel when 1C-EDO is already selected unless a separate explicit justification exists outside this pure contract.
A Diadoc OAuth identity with multiple boxes never grants them all: one concrete provider box is selected per organization binding.
A Saby connection is bound to one concrete provider organization/account.
Timeout after send is UNKNOWN, never success; UNKNOWN requires reconciliation before retry.
No apps/web, packages, lockfile, Prisma, auth, FGIS, banking, hosting or production mutation.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
requiredInvariants: EdoRoute is exactly ONE_C_EDO, DIRECT_DIADOC, DIRECT_SABY, OTHER_ADAPTER, MANUAL.

Provider-neutral state vocabulary is exactly DRAFT, READY_TO_SIGN, SIGNED, SUBMITTED, DELIVERED, COUNTERPARTY_ACTION_REQUIRED, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, CORRECTION_REQUIRED, ANNULMENT_PENDING, ANNULLED, ERROR, UNKNOWN.

EdoProviderAdapter exposes exactly connect, disconnect, health, listOrganizations, resolveCounterparty, checkRoute, createDraft, validate, send, getDocument, getStatus, accept, reject, requestCorrection, annul, getEvents, downloadOriginal, downloadSignatures, downloadServiceDocuments.
Diadoc binding is platform_org_id + provider_org_id + provider_box_id and box must be explicitly authorized/selected.
Saby binding is platform organization + provider organization + concrete provider account.
Unknown provider result is not retried before reconciliation.
requiredChecks: existing PC-CROP accounting and security gates
